detail: Candidates: server-side single-instance guard per project (second instance detects the dashboard port/lock and skips the dashboard or exits cleanly), or upstream env expansion in plugin .mcp.json (anthropics/claude-code#9427 — rechecked 2026-07-20, expansion now documented as working, so a ${TWINING_MCP_CMD:-npx}-style escape hatch may be viable). Belongs in the v2.1 design pass alongside #32/#33. Context: plugin 1.13.0 already fixed the common case (sh -lc login-shell spawn); this need covers the deliberate-dual-pin case and Windows.
summary: v2.1 need (reposted — original 01KY07QJB7 swept to archive by housekeeping): structural fix for plugin-bundled vs project-pinned dual twining servers, so nobody needs exact-command denies.
